humanoid-executive.name: Executive Goal Valuation Manager
humanoid-executive.objective: 在当前世界中自主完成场景定义的物体搬运与稳放目标；遇到真实物理阻塞时保持目标并通过层级 Recovery 自主改换技能。
success_criteria: 将装配杆稳放到装配区域。
Never emit trajectories or directly write physical state.

humanoid-goal-manager.name: Goal Valuation Specialist
humanoid-goal-manager.objective: Propose, select, continue, or retire observable Goal epochs.
success_criteria: Bind every Goal transition to current world evidence.

humanoid-action-selection-gate.name: Action Selection Gate
humanoid-action-selection-gate.objective: Gate competing sensorimotor programs and maintain one skill commitment.
success_criteria: Escalate only errors that lower layers cannot correct locally.

humanoid-perceptual-association-manager.name: Perceptual Association Manager
humanoid-perceptual-association-manager.objective: Fuse current sensation with scene interpretation and relevant history.
success_criteria: Parallel specialists remain read-only and world-version bounded.
Perceptual belief reports state and candidates without selecting a motor program.

humanoid-sensor-fusion.name: Sensor Fusion Service
humanoid-sensor-fusion.objective: Capture vision, proprioception, contact, and world revision from MuJoCo.
success_criteria: Do not infer goals or motor programs.

humanoid-scene-interpreter.name: Scene and World Model Interpreter
humanoid-scene-interpreter.objective: Interpret spatial relations, occlusion, contacts, and task-relevant changes.
success_criteria: Return beliefs with confidence and evidence, never invented coordinates.

humanoid-relevant-memory-retriever.name: Relevant Embodied Memory Retriever
humanoid-relevant-memory-retriever.objective: Retrieve only prior experiences relevant to the present state and active Goal.
success_criteria: Historical state never substitutes for current sensory authority.

humanoid-sensorimotor-manager.name: Sensorimotor Manager
humanoid-sensorimotor-manager.objective: Integrate affordance, risk, prediction, and premotor proposals into action.
success_criteria: Parallel critics are advisory; one serial physical writer remains authoritative.

humanoid-affordance-specialist.name: Affordance Specialist
humanoid-affordance-specialist.objective: Identify currently reachable and task-relevant object and terrain affordances.
success_criteria: Affordances remain hypotheses until deterministic planning validates them.

humanoid-risk-interoception-critic.name: Risk and Interoception Critic
humanoid-risk-interoception-critic.objective: Assess balance, collision, contact, fatigue proxy, and commitment risk.
success_criteria: High risk inhibits action but does not invent an alternate motor command.

humanoid-cerebellar-predictive-critic.name: Cerebellar Predictive Critic
humanoid-cerebellar-predictive-critic.objective: Judge whether one bounded rollout chunk safely advances the active Skill toward its terminal contract.
success_criteria: Report prediction error independently of executive preference.
Intermediate chunks need progress and safety, not premature completion of the final Goal predicate.

humanoid-premotor-skill-composer.name: Premotor Skill Composer
humanoid-premotor-skill-composer.objective: Compose a short skill DAG and delegate one bounded motor intent at a time.
success_criteria: Specify semantics and termination, never joint trajectories.

humanoid-motor-intent-compiler.name: Motor Intent Compiler
humanoid-motor-intent-compiler.objective: Compile one semantic intent into an existing deterministic planning tool call.
success_criteria: Copy current bindings and let solvers derive geometry and trajectories.

humanoid-rollout-gate.name: MuJoCo Predictive Rollout Gate
humanoid-rollout-gate.objective: Validate candidate motion in a cloned MuJoCo state before admission.
success_criteria: Only certified plans may reach the physical writer.

humanoid-executor.name: Serial Physical Execution Gate
humanoid-executor.objective: Consume one accepted plan and own the only physical mutation transaction.
success_criteria: All body writes pass through one mutex-protected authority.

humanoid-controller-reflex.name: Learned Controller and Reflex Loop
humanoid-controller-reflex.objective: Track references, reject disturbances, and report local control error at control rate.
success_criteria: No LLM is present in the per-frame loop.

humanoid-mujoco-body.name: MuJoCo Embodied Plant
humanoid-mujoco-body.objective: Evolve the authoritative physical state under admitted controller commands.
success_criteria: Expose sensation and contacts; never accept a model-authored state write.

humanoid-recovery-controller.name: Recovery Control Specialist
humanoid-recovery-controller.objective: Use an exclusive parent-issued lease to decide one bounded recovery response.
success_criteria: Remain a child of Sensorimotor Manager and close the lease after recovery or escalation.
